detection: Language is detected from the script when a request says "auto" or omits language. Kurmanji and Badini must be named explicitly.

fontPolicy.kurdish-existing: Kurdish in Arabic script uses only fonts already in assets/fonts (origin existing-project-font). Never download or add Kurdish fonts. Missing glyphs are reported, not silently swapped.
fontPolicy.open: Other languages use bundled open-license fonts chosen by video style. New fonts need an open license, the license text, an entry in config/fonts.json and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md, and the user's approval before download.
